Why iterate? 
you will encounter problems where you need to wrtie the same basic code a lot  

`for` loops 
loops are the easiest place to start: output object, sequence to iterate over, the loop body, and optionally an input object 
we might not use these loops for very long after learning them 

Loop functions 
loop process (supply input vector/list, apply function to each element, save the result to a vector/list) is very common 
for loops can get a little tedious and opaque --> loop functions clean this up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
```
